Frequently Asked Questions
How can I apply for admission at LGU?

chunks.title: Admissions at LGU
chunks.text:
You can apply online through the LGU Admissions Portal (admissions.lgu.edu.pk). Simply register an account, fill in your personal and academic details, upload the required documents, and submit your application. You can track your progress directly from the dashboard.
What are the eligibility criteria for Undergraduate programs?
For most Bachelor's (BS) programs, candidates must have completed Intermediate (HSSC) or equivalent with a minimum of 45% to 50% marks. Specific computing, science, or professional programs may require higher marks and relevant subject combinations.
Is there an entry test requirement?
Admissions to MS/MPhil and PhD programs require clearing the LGU Graduate Admission Test or HEC-approved tests. Some specialized undergraduate programs also require departmental entry tests or interviews, which will be scheduled via your portal.
Does LGU offer scholarships or financial aid?

chunks.title: Admissions at LGU
chunks.text:
Yes, LGU offers a wide range of scholarships, including Merit-based scholarships (based on entry marks/GPA), Kinship discounts, Army/Garrison wards concessions, and need-based financial aid. These can be applied for after securing admission.
How are merit lists determined and when are they displayed?
Merit lists are calculated based on your academic weights (Matriculation, Intermediate, and entry test results if applicable). Selected candidates are notified via SMS/Email, and merit lists are posted on the LGU website and campus boards.
Can I edit my application form after submitting?
Before submitting, you can save and edit your form. Once submitted, changes are locked. If you need to correct critical details, you must contact the LGU Admissions Support Desk or visit the admissions office for assistance.
Need Personal Guidance?
Our admission counselors are available Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM to help you.

Garrison Counselling Centre
Our Vision & Mission
Vision
Enriching psychological wellness through exemplary, evidence-based mental health services for the community.
Mission
Garrison counselling Centre aims to provide comprehensive, confidential, and client-centered mental health services through a highly trained professional team, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and specialized therapeutic interventions tailored to diverse psychological needs.
Services Provided
Scope of Services
The University Counselling Center provides short-term psychological support for students experiencing academic stress, adjustment concerns, and mild to moderate emotional or behavioral difficulties.
Students who have received appropriate medical or psychiatric treatment and are in a clinically stable condition may subsequently access counseling services at the Center for supportive care. This includes assistance with emotional regulation, coping strategies, academic functioning, and reintegration into university life.

chunks.title: Lahore Garrison University

All services are delivered in accordance with ethical guidelines, confidentiality standards, and institutional policies. This framework ensures safe, appropriate, and responsible management of student well-being while maintaining clear professional boundaries and duty of care.

Teaching and Learning Difficulties in Academic Institutions
Workplace Adjustment Difficulties in Industries/Organizations
Psychological Testing & Assessment (Intelligence, Personality, Aptitude etc.)
Interventions (Assessment, Diagnostics, Therapeutics)
Career Choices and Counselling
Need Based Counselling
Group Counselling / Therapy
Prevention and Counselling in Drug Addiction
Prevention of Thalassemia Awareness Programs
General Health Maintenance and Promotion Programs
Workshops, Seminars and Conferences on Individual, Community and National Mental Health Issues.

LGU Community (LGU Students, Faculty and Staff)

chunks.title: Lahore Garrison University
chunks.text:
Students must complete a Registration Form and an Informed Consent Form prior to counseling. Through e-mail appointments are scheduled.
Appointment Process
1
Students may access the center through their Batch Coordinator, Faculty Member, Head of Department, or the Student Affairs Department to register and avail of the facilities offered.
2
Students may also self-refer.
3
Students can also be referred to the centre by parents, or peers.
4
Registration forms and consent forms are to be filled by the student before the actual counselling session begins.
Confidentiality Policy
The policies of the counselling centre, the ethical principles of counseling professionals, and the legal policies consider it important to protect the confidentiality of the information received in the interaction between a student and a counselor.
The counselor will not speak with parents, teachers, friends or anyone else above their concerns without the permission of the respective student
The documents that counselor have such as a case history will also be maintained confidential.

chunks.title: Department of Allied Health and Molecular Sciences
chunks.text: The rapid convergence of molecular biology, genomics, biotechnology, artificial intelligence, and digital healthcare is transforming the future of medicine and life sciences. At the Department of Allied Health and Molecular Sciences, we are committed to preparing the next generation of scientists, healthcare professionals, and innovators who will lead this transformation and contribute to improving human health and societal well-being. Our department proudly offers undergraduate programs in BS Biotechnology, BS Human Nutrition and Dietetics, and BS Genetics . Our BS Human Nutrition and Dietetics program is accredited by the Allied Health Professionals Council (AHPC), Government of Pakistan. These programs are designed to provide students with a strong scientific foundation while equipping them with the knowledge and practical skills required to thrive in an era of precision medicine, genomic technologies, bioinformatics, artificial intelligence, and evidence-based healthcare.

chunks.title: Department of Allied Health and Molecular Sciences
chunks.text: We envision a future where biological discoveries are translated into innovative solutions for disease prevention, diagnosis, personalized treatment, sustainable healthcare, food security, and environmental sustainability. Our academic philosophy emphasizes interdisciplinary learning by integrating biological sciences with computational tools, data science, molecular diagnostics, and emerging healthcare technologies. Through research-driven education, advanced laboratory training, industrial collaborations, internships, and community engagement, we cultivate graduates who are analytical thinkers, ethical professionals, and lifelong learners. Research and innovation are at the heart of our mission. We encourage our students and faculty to explore frontier areas including genomics, molecular medicine, precision nutrition, biotechnology, artificial intelligence in healthcare, computational biology, and translational research. By fostering a culture of scientific inquiry and innovation, we aim to generate impactful research that addresses local and global healthcare challenges while contributing to the advancement of science and technology. Our distinguished faculty members are dedicated to creating an inclusive, collaborative, and intellectually stimulating environment where curiosity is encouraged, creativity is nurtured, and excellence is celebrated. We continuously strengthen our academic programs through curriculum innovation, strategic partnerships, and the adoption of emerging technologies to ensure our graduates remain competitive in both national and international arenas.

The Department provides state-of-the-art teaching laboratories, modern research facilities, and opportunities for experiential learning that enable students to translate theoretical knowledge into practical applications. How to Apply Online at LGU

Step 1: Go to the Admissions Portal - Visit admissions.lgu.edu.pk to start your application.
Step 2: Click on "Apply Now" on the portal homepage.
Step 3: Find Your Program - Browse the list of offered programs.
Step 4: Click Apply Now for Your Program.
Step 5: Fill Out the Admission Form with accurate details.
Step 6: Enter Degree Information about your current or most recent degree.
Step 7: Enter Personal Information (name, date of birth, CNIC, etc.).
Step 8: Enter Contact Information (phone, email, mailing address).
Step 9: Enter Previous Academic Information and grades.
Step 10: Garrison Institution Children (Optional) - enter details if applicable.
Step 11: Upload Required Documents (transcripts, CNIC, photographs).
Step 12: Submit Your Application - click Submit. You can then download the application form along with the challan form for fee payment.
